title: Coral and the Cover
author: Tamsin Pemberton
blurb: Beatrix Blackwood, an interpreter attached to a peace delegation destined to fail, hasn't slept through the night since the incident. Then every record of a flight vanishes while it's still in the air — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must trade the one secret worth killing for before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
